user_intent: Create coherent, source-driven internal interactive review of electronics→functional stacks→PrintCeptor→Römer, Eco, EMASSC→Mark/Luke/InterSol, with high-fidelity media where exact geometry exists, and continue software proof across all domains via existing CGX/LightSpeed owners and automations.

immutables.source_owner_rule: Consume latest exact authoritative Git/Drive/CGX root references; derivative views never rewrite source, licenses, geometry, safety, DBR or root authority.
immutables.single_runtime: Use existing LightSpeed GO, Achilles P.A, LightSpeed operations, Quests and CGX resolver; no second CGX catalogue/master/agent/heartbeat.
immutables.schedule: Neo :00; R1 :11 intentionally disabled; R2 :22 fallback; R3 :33; Achilles :44. Existing local Merovingian and Windows guard remain sole local schedules. No changes to their cadence.
immutables.host: BouwerBase currentness/readback and owner permissions verified before any local mutation. RPC timeout => HOST_UNAVAILABLE_HOLD and provider-only task. Never touch Windows Documents.
immutables.security: Internal review media must remain under authenticated/private CGX review root; never copy into public/, dist/ or static without separately accepted access control. No credential values in artifacts.
immutables.scientific: Evidence class distinguishes published measured/qualified source, derived physics, simulated/synthetic, analogue, concept, unknown and physical NOT_RUN. Geometry does not prove material, rating or full 4D acceptance.
immutables.privacy: Personal contexts and CGX family Dataspace are access-scoped, never bulk hydrated, exfiltrated or included in shared review previews.
immutables.owner_gate: Changes to Raphael UTP PR5, Data PostMix PR11, LightSpeed canonical, CGX S92 and public CCC/CYC require their independent owner operations; this packet lives only in PrintSpace PR6.

review_ui_contract.palette: Dark-neutral base, teal interface primary, green verified source/software, gold provisional/inferred, red blocked/safety. Never infer functional material specifications from colors.
review_ui_contract.rendering: High fidelity and 4K dimensions conditional on actual promoted CAD/mesh and local rendering budget; SVG technical diagrams already existing should be reused.
